summary: Preserve FIFO ordering among Immediates queued for the same check-phase iteration.

target.notes: Use the Node-compatible event-loop runtime; do not map ordering to arbitrary Task/ThreadPool scheduling.

semantics.ordering: callbacks execute in creation order within the Immediate queue
semantics.queue_processing: the current Immediate queue is processed as one check-phase batch

caveats: FIFO applies within the same Immediate queue; other phase work and nested scheduling have separate rules.

tests.name: three immediates keep FIFO
tests.expected_behavior: prints a b c in that order
